kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستسلم (form X)
# أَسْتَسْلِمُ (ʔastaslimu) /ʔas.tas.li.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَسْلَمَ (istaslama)
# أَسْتَسْلِمَ (ʔastaslima) /ʔas.tas.li.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَسْلَمَ (istaslama)
# أَسْتَسْلِمْ (ʔastaslim) /ʔas.tas.lim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَسْلَمَ (istaslama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
